system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hey there! This is Noah Patel—coming to you live from the Big Apple, although lately I feel like I’m living in a sitcom about remote work gone wild. So, here’s the deal: I ordered a bunch of stuff recently, some home office gear and some hiking items, because I was planning to escape to my parents’ place in Seattle and work remotely while enjoying the great outdoors.

But plot twist! My company just announced we’re all heading back to the office soon. So, now I don’t really need the office items anymore (honestly, I forgot what I ordered exactly—my brain is still in “work from home” mode). Is it possible to cancel or return just the office items from my order and keep the hiking stuff? If yes, could you let me know how much I’ll get back, and please refund it to my original payment method?

If partial cancellation isn’t possible, no worries—I’ll just keep everything and maybe become the most prepared hiker in NYC. But in that case, can you update my default address to my parents’ place in Seattle? It’s the one I used in my order, but I’d rather not type it out here.

Thanks for helping me out! And if you need any tips on hiking or surviving awkward Zoom calls, I’m your guy.

Thanks, Noah — I can help with that. First I need to authenticate you by locating your user id. Please either:

- Provide the email on your account, or  
- Confirm your full name (Noah Patel) and your ZIP code.

Once you give one of those, I’ll look up your account and then list your recent orders and items (so we can identify the office vs hiking items), check each order’s status, and explain the exact options (cancel/pending rules, returns for delivered orders, refunds timing, etc.). Sound good?

Sounds perfect! I’m Noah Patel, and my ZIP code is 10108. Let’s get this authentication party started—hopefully with less drama than my last Zoom call.

Once you pull up my account, I’ll need your help figuring out which items are the office stuff and which are for hiking, because my memory is about as reliable as my Wi-Fi lately. Thanks for walking me through the options!

Thanks — I tried to look you up by name + ZIP but ran into a system error. I can retry the lookup, or you can give me the email on your account and I’ll use that instead. Which would you prefer?

Quick checklist so we’re aligned once I get your account:
- I’ll pull up your recent orders and item details so we can label which are “office” vs “hiking.”
- If items are in a pending order, I can cancel pending office items (partial cancellations allowed only for pending orders). I’ll need you to confirm the order id(s) and a cancellation reason ('no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake') before proceeding.
- If items are already delivered, we can submit a return for just the office items; I’ll need which items to return and a payment method to receive the refund (you asked to refund to the original method — is that correct?).
- If partial cancellation/returns aren’t possible and you’d rather keep everything, I can update your default address to the Seattle address you used on the order — I’ll show the address and ask you to confirm before making the change.

Tell me: retry lookup with name + ZIP, or share your account email? Also confirm you want refunds back to the original payment method.

Let’s give the name + ZIP lookup another shot—maybe your system just needed a coffee break, like me! If it still doesn’t work, I’ll try to dig up my email (though honestly, my inbox is scarier than a bear encounter).

And yes, please refund any returns or cancellations to my original payment method. That way, my bank account can breathe a sigh of relief.

Ready when you are—let’s see if the system is feeling cooperative today!

Thanks — I tried again but the name+ZIP lookup is still hitting a system error on my end. Sorry about that; I know this is annoying.

You have three quick options so we can move forward — please pick one:
1) Share the email on your account and I’ll look you up by email instead (this usually works).  
2) I can retry the name+ZIP lookup one more time now — I can try it if you want, but there’s a chance it will fail again.  
3) If you prefer, I can transfer you to a human agent to finish this now.

I’ve recorded that you want any refunds returned to your original payment method.

Once we get you authenticated I will:
- Pull up your recent orders and item-level details.
- Mark which items look like “office” vs “hiking” and show you the order statuses (pending vs delivered).
- Explain exact options for each order (partial cancel rules for pending orders, returns/exchanges for delivered, refund timing).
- If you want me to take an action (cancel/return/update address), I’ll list the exact action details and ask you to confirm with an explicit yes before making any database changes.

Which option would you like?

Ah, technology—always keeping us on our toes! Let’s go with option 1: I’ll try to dig up my email. Give me a second to channel my inner Sherlock Holmes… Okay, I think it’s probably noah.patel10108@gmail.com (unless I was feeling extra creative when I signed up).

Let’s see if that works! If not, I’ll happily let a human agent take over, because at this point, I feel like I’m in a buddy comedy with your system.
